backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining categories, subcategories, and storage/authorization mixins for worker-related data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a requirement to generate missing SVG icons for category taxonomy.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text index summarizing major frontend files including styles, components, pages, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry loading the React app with metadata and root mount node.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router, global layout, and query/i18n providers.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Admin access wrapper enforcing Internet Identity login and admin-role checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Admin list UI allowing pending or all job posts to be reviewed, approved, or rejected.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Shows pending or all workers for admin review and provides approve, reject, verify, and feature controls with loading states.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component that swaps to a fallback icon if the main source is missing or fails to load.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Renders English and regional text stacked with customizable styling classes.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides app-wide state-based language selection and a translation lookup function.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Displays approved job postings with bilingual headings, loading states, and call buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer with bilingual text, contact link, app info, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Responsive header with navigation, state selector, mobile menu, and app name display.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: Displays a worker profile card with photo, details, contact actions, and safe fallbacks for missing fields.
Defines category groups and subcategories for local skilled workers plus a helper to flatten subcategory labels.
frontend/src/config/payment.ts: Empty configuration file for payment settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides admin mutations for approving, rejecting, verifying, featuring, and unfeaturing workers and jobs, with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking through context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for fetching workers, jobs, admin status, and user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollToSection.ts: Empty hook file with no implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Hook that queries workers from backend based on area, category, or subcategory and sanitizes the returned worker objects.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTaxonomy.ts: Hook that fetches worker categories and subcategories with fallbacks and builds a cleaned taxonomy map.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining theme color tokens, typography, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App bootstrap that sets up React Query, Internet Identity, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabs to review worker registrations and job posts, wrapped by an admin guard.
frontend/src/pages/AllovikaasLandingPage: Empty placeholder file for a landing page component.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page with search bar, category navigation, bilingual labels, and navigation logic for searching workers.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Form page allowing users to submit job requests, validating inputs and sending data to backend.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Worker registration form with validation, photo upload, taxonomy selection, and backend submission.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Search results page that normalizes URL params, syncs them with state, and queries workers based on area, category, and subcategory.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Maps worker groups and subcategories to i18n keys and returns bilingual labels with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Provides safe extraction and logging of error messages from unknown values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, radii, shadows, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the AREA WORKARS platform, architecture notes, known issues, and required image assets.
